description: This file defines the class Zend_Http_UserAgent_Desktop, which extends Zend_Http_UserAgent_AbstractDevice, representing a desktop browser user agent detector within the Zend Framework's HTTP UserAgent handling classes.

classes.name: Zend_Http_UserAgent_Desktop
classes.description: Represents a desktop browser user agent type matcher in the Zend Framework HTTP UserAgent component. It always matches as a desktop and provides the browser type.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Always returns true, indicating this class always considers the user agent as a desktop browser.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the string 'desktop' indicating the user agent type.
